rules.name: Continuous employment required
rules.impact: Disproportionately eliminates qualified re-entry talent without measuring actual capability.
rules.recommended_intervention: Eliminate continuity as a mandatory gate; evaluate cumulative years and recent problem-solving.

rules.name: Exact most-recent-title match
rules.impact: Excludes adjacent career-transition candidates with strong transferable skill overlap.
rules.recommended_intervention: Implement skill-vector adjacency matching across related functional roles.

rules.name: Recent mandatory certification
rules.impact: Imposes a credential tax on candidates, although research found generic upskilling certificates did not raise callbacks.
rules.recommended_intervention: Replace recency criteria with focused practical capability verification assessments.

rules.name: Exact employment dates mandatory
rules.impact: Forces employment gaps to stay visible; research found duration-based framing improves callbacks over date-based resumes.
rules.recommended_intervention: Accept experience-duration summaries alongside, or instead of, month-and-year dates.

rules.name: Graduation-year cut-off
rules.impact: Excludes experienced professionals returning after a break regardless of current capability.
rules.recommended_intervention: Replace graduation-year limits with a demonstrated-competency evaluation.

rules.name: Recent hands-on usage window
rules.impact: Rewards toolchain recency over transferable capability and can screen out re-entry candidates whose core skills remain relevant.
rules.recommended_intervention: Use a short practical capability check for the specific tool instead of a recency window.
